picks.reason: Houston should win, but 12.5 is about double a model edge already dented by Hunter and Harrison being questionable.
Kansas City wins clearly, but even docking Arizona for Minshew the margin still lands short of 15.5.
Lamar Jackson is on IR and Baltimore has been scoring like a different team, so Carolina is the side at home.
Buffalo is the right winner, but the model's 13-point edge does not support laying 16.5.
New Orleans is down its center and both tackle spots, so Chicago's edge grows past 11.5.
Pittsburgh should win a low-scoring game, but a four-point model edge is not enough to lay 4.5.
Detroit's offense is good enough to win, but missing Hutchinson, Joseph, and Campbell makes laying 7 too many.
Dallas should win a shootout, but a minus-4 defense and a seven-point model edge make 8.5 too big.
The model and the market are essentially the same, and neither injury report settles a three-point game.
Jacksonville is the top-rated team in the league and the model margin already clears six.
Denver should win by about the posted number, and neither injury report creates a real side.
On a neutral field the ratings are a point apart, and Minnesota's defense is good enough to nick San Francisco.

home.IND@HOU: A 12-5 Houston team that just scored 44 on the road buries the 25th-ranked Colts, who allowed 42 at Jacksonville, and covers 12.5 indoors.
home.ARI@KC: Kansas City, 7-2 and rated +3.7, just scored 35 twice, while Arizona, missing Minshew and Conner, was routed 34-6, so the Chiefs cover 15.5.
home.BAL@CAR: Carolina covers at home against a Ravens team without Lamar Jackson that has lost five straight, including 36-10 at Buffalo.
home.MIA@BUF: Buffalo, second overall at +6.7 and averaging 31.9, just beat Baltimore 36-10 and covers 16.5 against a 1-8 Miami offense rated -3.7.
home.NO@CHI: Chicago opened with 59 and rates +3.9 against a Saints line with McCoy and Fuaga doubtful, covering 11.5 at home.
home.PIT@PHI: Philadelphia's +0.2 defense keeps Pittsburgh's -0.7 offense, which just scored 18 in a road loss at Cincinnati, inside the 4.5 number at home.
home.TB@DET: Detroit's +3.7 offense averages 28.6 and just won 35-10, covering seven indoors against a 3-6 Buccaneers team with Baker Mayfield questionable.
home.TEN@DAL: Dallas's +3.4 offense averages 28.6 indoors against Tennessee, 32nd at -6.8 and 1-8, so the Cowboys cover 8.5.
home.NYJ@LAC: The Chargers, who just won 23-20 at Baltimore, are rated -4.2 against the Jets' -5.8 with Geno Smith questionable, covering 3.5 at home.
home.JAX@NYG: The Giants are 5-3-1, rated only -1.3, and just won 19-11 at Philadelphia, so they cover six at home.
home.LV@DEN: Denver, 7-2 with a +2.2 defense and +3.9 rating, covers ten at home against a Raiders defense rated -3.4 that allows 28.9.
home.MIN@SF: San Francisco's +4.2 offense scored 46 at Dallas and the team rates +5.1, covering three against Minnesota's -2.1 offense.
home.CIN@WSH: Washington covers 6.5 at home: the projection is only a five-point Cincinnati win, and the Commanders just beat Philadelphia 27-10.

away.IND@HOU: Indianapolis already beat Houston 19-17, and a 12.5 line doubles the model's 6.2 edge with Hunter and Harrison questionable.
away.ARI@KC: Arizona won 33-30 at Dallas, and Kansas City's 15.5 line far exceeds the model's 10.4 edge with Walker and Moore questionable.
away.BAL@CAR: Baltimore rates -2.3 against Carolina's -2, so plus 2.5 covers a 1.8 model edge.
away.MIA@BUF: Buffalo's 16.5 number tops the model's 13.3 edge, and Miami just took Indianapolis to a 22-24 finish.
away.NO@CHI: Chicago's 11.5 line exceeds the model's 8.9 edge, and Gordon, Muhammad, and Stevenson are all questionable.
away.PIT@PHI: Philadelphia is 2-7 and scores 16.4 a game, while Pittsburgh's +1.5 defense faces an offense rated -3.7.
away.TB@DET: Tampa allows 19.8 and blanked Atlanta 16-0, while Detroit misses Hutchinson, Joseph, and Campbell as a seven-point favorite.
away.TEN@DAL: Dallas allows 28.2 with a -4.1 defense and Bland out, so Tennessee plus 8.5 cashes after scoring 36 at Cincinnati.
away.NYJ@LAC: The Chargers are 1-8 and score 16 a game, so laying 3.5 fails against a Jets club that beat Tennessee and Cleveland.
away.JAX@NYG: Jacksonville is rated +6.7, first of 32, allows 16 a game, and the 6.5 model margin clears six.
away.LV@DEN: Las Vegas scores 25.1, the model margin is 9.1, and Denver's +0.2 offense cannot justify laying 10.
away.MIN@SF: Minnesota allows 14 with a +5.6 defense, and San Francisco's three-point line dwarfs a one-point model edge on a neutral field.
away.CIN@WSH: Cincinnati scores 30.9 and just beat Pittsburgh 38-18, so minus 6.5 is comfortable against a Washington team missing Tunsil.
